name: organoid_drug_coverage
claim: Drug overlap by normalised name across candidate delta-transfer corpora and the sarcoma organoid panel. The organoid screen carries 34 drugs; L1000 covers 25, GDSC2 covers 21, Tahoe covers 8. This refutes substituting Tahoe for L1000 as the Path B transfer corpus on drug grounds, despite Tahoe giving the wider gene panel (12597 vs 8600). The organoid_generated row uses Broad BRD-K compound ids, a separate namespace, so its zeros are artifacts and not findings.
